items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: And you know old God was to play some trumpets, you know?

ctx.x: How many cymbals did you use?

I used one crash cymbal. Chinese? Chinese crash cymbal. And hit it wide open. Oh man, the drummer was a noisy thing. And the people liked that noise, you know? And another thing too, again, in the days like that, it looked like the lollier play, a lot of people like it. Like that Mr. Clot Miller, buddy, you know? Y'all heard of Blind Gilbert? Oh yeah, I know him. You used to work with him? Eh? No, no, I didn't work with him, but one time we, you see when they draw the crowd, they had my brother and Louis…
Yeah, I was gonna ask you.
